tha-ap338:1.1: padumuttarabhagavato → padumuttarassa bhagavato (bj) | bhagavato → padumuttara bhagavato (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap338:1.3: vipine → pavane (sya-all) | vipine cetiyaṁ → pavane cetiyam (pts)
tha-ap338:2.4: āsi → G. phaluggāmasi; S2 paduggam āsi. (pts note)
tha-ap338:3.2: pitumātumatenahaṁ → pitāpetāmahenahaṁ (sya-all); pitupetāmahen ahaṁ (pts) | pitupetāmahena’haṁ → pitumātumatenahaṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | pitumātumatenahaṁ → pitupetāmahenahaṁ (cck: sī.); pitāpetāmahenahaṁ (cck: syā.)
tha-ap338:4.2: upaṭṭhahiṁ → G. upaṭṭhayim; S1 upaṭṭhayi. (pts note)
tha-ap338:4.4: acchatī → acchati (sya-all) | acchatī → G. S1 acchati. (pts note)
tha-ap338:6.1: tiṇakaṭṭhañca → tiṇaṁ kaṭṭhañca (bj) | kaṭṭhañca → tiṇakaṭṭhañca (bj: machasaṁ) | ca → G. valli; S2 vallī. (pts note)
tha-ap338:6.3: aṭṭha vārāni paṭikuṭiko → aṭṭhavārāni patikuṭiko (bj) | vārāni → aṭṭha ṭhānāni (cck: ka.)
tha-ap338:6.4: paṭikuṭiko → S1 -kuṭiyo. (pts note) | ahaṁ → S1 agacchāhaṁ; G. agacchi 'haṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap338:11.1: sivikā → siviyā (sya-all) | sivikā hatthikhandhena vipine → siviyā hatthikkhandhena pavane (pts)
tha-ap338:11.4: sampate → sampajjate (sya-all) | sampate vanaṁ → sampajjate dhanaṁ (pts) | sampajjate → sampate (bj: machasaṁ) | sampate → sijjhate (cck: ka.) | dhanaṁ → G. sammajjate vanaṁ; S1 -vanaṁ (pts note)
tha-ap338:13.3: daddu → dadduṁ (bj) | kacchu → kaṇḍu (sya-all) | kacchu → kaṇḍu (cck: syā.) | kaṇḍu → G. kaṇṭhu; S1 kaṇḍo. (pts note)
tha-ap338:14.2: buddhathūpassa sodhane → buddhathūpamhi sodhite (sya-all) | sodhite → budadhathūpassa sodhane (bj: sīmu) | sodhane → buddhathūpamhi sodhite (cck: syā.) | sodhane → G. buddhathūpamhi sodhite. (pts note)
tha-ap338:14.4: piḷakabindukaṁ → pilakabindukaṁ (bj) | piḷakabindukaṁ aññampi → pilakabindukaṁ aññaṁ pi (pts) | pilakabindukaṁ → S1 -pindukaṁ; S2 -bindhukaṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap338:15.2: sodhite → sabbatthapi evameva dissati, tathā uparipi (cck note)
tha-ap338:17.3: vivajjati → vivajjeti (sya-all) | vivajjati manāpaṁ → vivajjeti manāpam (pts)
tha-ap338:19.4: arahattamapāpuṇiṁ satasahassito → arahattaṁ apāpuṇiṁ satasahasse ito (sya-all, pts)
